summary.tldr: Gives effect to the Anishinabek Nation Governance Agreement and updates self-government laws for the shíshálh Nation and Yukon First Nations.
what_it_does: Enacts the Anishinabek Nation Governance Agreement Act and makes related and consequential changes to other laws.
Updates the Sechelt Indian Band Self-Government Act to set required parts of the shíshálh Nation’s constitution and to make its constitution and laws publicly accessible.
Clarifies that the shíshálh Nation council may make laws on child and family services, and sets how lands in British Columbia may become shíshálh lands.
Allows the Minister of Crown-Indigenous Relations to make an agreement for a shíshálh Lands Register, and removes the need for Governor in Council approval for certain funding agreements.
States that the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms applies to the shíshálh Nation Council, the shíshálh Nation Government District Council, and related administrative bodies and agencies.
Amends the Yukon First Nations Self-Government Act so funding agreements no longer need Governor in Council approval.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the Senate on 9 June 2022.
